description: C pre-dispatch and post-dispatch local cancellation with fresh-client recovery
qualification: Local normal node built from combined unmerged source, separately built client candidate and disposable signer; not hosted or distribution qualification.
preDispatch: Local cancellation before polling produced exactly one callback with not-dispatched outcome and original selector.
limitations: Post-dispatch cancellation followed a durable business rejection while the response was withheld; cancellation during commit and after successful commitment remain untested.
The proxy counted the observed request stream and no additional queued connections; this is not a universal retry proof.
The fixture deliberately made a separate changed-input conflict probe and a distinct later business command; neither was an automatic retry.
Guest execution count was not independently measured. All later effects were acknowledged before the controlled crash.
A preceding C recovery lookup returned gRPC 8 and a separate read observed the original; its capacity owner remains unclassified.
